message.mars_command.mission: [Mars Command] Mission #%s: %s | %s (%s, %s, %s) | %s%% complete | %s active seconds remaining
message.mars_command.no_missions: [Mars Command] You have no active assignments.
message.mars_command.expired: [Mars Command] Mission #%s missed its deadline. Score: %s | Rank: %s
message.mars_command.reassigned: [Mars Command] Mission #%s has been reassigned. Score: %s | Rank: %s
message.mars_command.refused: [Mars Command] Refusal recorded for mission #%s. The obligation remains. Score: %s | Rank: %s
message.mars_command.refusal_warning: Refusing mission #%s costs %s score. Select Confirm Refusal to accept this penalty.
message.mars_command.unavailable: [Mars Command] Transmissions are unavailable. Ask a server operator to check the server log.
gui.mars_command.title: MARS COMMAND // MISSION RECORD
gui.mars_command.held_stack: Put the held item stack down before opening Mars Command
gui.mars_command.select: Select a mission node to inspect its orders.
gui.mars_command.sync_error: Mission synchronization failed. Use Refresh in Mars Command to retry.
gui.mars_command.action_timeout: The mission action was not confirmed. Refresh your record before retrying.
arrival.mars_command.title: Player ID
arrival.mars_command.welcome: Welcome to the Overworld, Player %s. The Moon requires confirmation of your arrival. Open Player ID in Mars Command to sign in on the website.
arrival.mars_command.welcome_local: Welcome to the Overworld, Player %s. The Moon acknowledges your arrival. Website confirmation is not required in this world.
arrival.mars_command.enable: Require website confirmation on server worlds
arrival.mars_command.settings_help: Single-player never requires a website link. Use only a trusted API: the server sends its integration credential there. Keys stay in the server environment, never in this menu.
arrival.mars_command.instructions: Sign in using the website button, approve your player ID, then review and confirm the displayed account here. Missions wait until arrival is confirmed.
arrival.mars_command.local_explanation: This world uses its own permanent callsign registry. No website login or remote data is required.
arrival.mars_command.stale: Remote data is unavailable or being refreshed. Any saved confirmation remains valid for the same API.
arrival.mars_command.review_account: Website approval received for %s. Review and confirm this account in Player ID.
arrival.mars_command.confirmed: Arrival confirmed, Player %s. Await the Moon's orders.
arrival.mars_command.remote_error: The Moon's remote link is unavailable. Your saved identity is preserved; retry later.
arrival.mars_command.not_configured: Website arrival is unavailable. Ask the server owner to check its integration key, URLs and online-mode setting.
arrival.mars_command.capacity: All 10,000 local callsigns are reserved. Ask the world owner for assistance.
arrival.mars_command.state.approved: Website approval received; in-game confirmation required.
arrival.mars_command.state.expired: Confirmation expired. Start a new link.
arrival.mars_command.state.denied: This confirmation link is no longer active.
